requirements.body: The system shall provide exactly six network modes: `offline_hotspot`, `wifi_router`, `wifi_bridge`, `android_tether`, `wifi_client`, `eth_client`.
While hardware required by a mode is absent, the system shall hide that mode from the operator's selectable set (Article VII).
The system shall apply mode-specific iptables rules via the HAL `hal/internal/handlers/firewall.go` endpoints (NO per-mode .nft template files — rules are constructed in code).
The system shall reset CubeOS-managed firewall rules when entering a new mode (no cross-mode leakage).
While in `offline_hotspot`, the system shall block all outbound internet traffic at the firewall level (defense-in-depth for Article III).
The system shall store WiFi credentials in `/cubeos/config/secrets.env` with mode `0600`, NEVER in any database.
The system shall NEVER log WiFi credentials to any log file.
